post.description:
Email a one-time sign-in link to a confirmed address. The same answer whether or not an
account has it, and at most one a minute per account.

The emailed link, opened. The authenticator step still applies when it's on; the link is
only spent once everything checks out, so a missing code doesn't burn it.
Email a reset link. The same answer whether or not the account exists or has an email.
The emailed confirmation link. Works signed in or out (it may open on another device).

Challenge a member to a duel, or open a group battle: a club room whose first game is the
battle. Nobody stakes anything; the winner's prize comes from the platform.

Members leave freely. The owner hands the club over first, unless they're the last one in
(then the club closes).
Stop (or restart) hearing about games filling up in this club.
Open a room for the club: its members see it on the club page and can walk in.
Say you're up for a game (any, or one pick) for 30, 60 or 120 minutes.

Tap through to the match: the first one in opens the room and hosts it, the rest join it.
Club members who weren't up can join too, as long as there's a seat.
